product_overview: ScrapyCoco is a web-based admin suite for managing football-data scrapers, showing live execution logs, previews, exports, history, scheduling, and diagnostics without using a terminal. It combines a FastAPI backend with a lightweight browser UI to simplify scraper operations and monitoring.
core_goals: List and execute all supported football-data scrapers from a central web dashboard
Provide real-time execution visibility through SSE logs and batch progress updates
Enable preview, validation, and export of scraped data in multiple formats
Track execution history and aggregate scraper performance metrics
Support automated scraper scheduling with pause, resume, delete, and run-now actions
Monitor scraper resilience by analyzing HTML structure changes over time

features.name: Scraper Management API
features.description: Lets users view all supported scrapers, run one scraper at a time, or launch multiple scrapers sequentially while monitoring live status and logs.
user_flows: GET /api/scrapers -> Receive 200 with 8 scraper records and current statuses -> GET /api/run/xg with valid match_id, team_name, type, and sandbox params -> Receive SSE start, log, and end events -> Scraper completes with exit_code and updated status
GET /api/run/fake -> Receive 404 scraper not found -> No execution stream is opened

POST /api/batch/run with body {scraper_ids:["xg","cards"],sandbox:true} -> Receive 200 SSE batch-start event -> Receive progress events for each scraper -> Receive end event after sequential execution
GET /api/run/flashscore with browser binary missing -> Receive SSE log events showing execution failure -> Receive end event with error status and non-zero exit code

features.name: Preview & Export
features.description: Allows users to preview extracted data in sandbox mode, inspect validation warnings, and export datasets as CSV, JSON, or Excel with optional transformations.
user_flows: GET /api/preview/xg -> Receive 200 with columns, rows, total, and warnings for sandbox preview -> POST /api/export with body {scraper_id:"xg",format:"csv",transforms:[],preview_data:[...]} -> Receive binary file download
GET /api/preview/results -> Receive response indicating preview is not supported for legacy script-based scrapers -> User cannot proceed to export from preview for that scraper
POST /api/export with body {scraper_id:"xg",format:"xml",transforms:[],preview_data:[...]} -> Receive validation error due to unsupported format -> No file download is returned
GET /api/preview/transfermarkt -> Receive 200 preview data when browser prerequisites are available -> POST /api/export with body including transforms -> Receive transformed Excel download

features.name: Execution History
features.description: Shows past scraper runs with pagination and provides aggregate metrics and per-scraper statistics for reporting and charting.
user_flows: GET /api/history -> Receive 200 array of execution records with scraper_id, status, duration, and records_count -> GET /api/history/metrics -> Receive 200 aggregated totals and success rate -> GET /api/history/stats -> Receive 200 per-scraper statistics for chart rendering
GET /api/history?limit=invalid -> Receive validation or request handling error response -> No history records are returned
GET /api/history/metrics after repeated failed runs -> Receive updated error_count and reduced success_rate -> GET /api/history/stats -> Receive per-scraper error counts reflecting recent failures

features.name: Scheduler
features.description: Manages automated scraper jobs by listing schedules, adding new jobs, pausing or resuming them, deleting them, and triggering immediate execution.
user_flows: GET /api/scheduler/list -> Receive 200 array of scheduled jobs -> POST /api/scheduler/add with body {scraper_id:"xg",cron_expression:"0 6 * * *",params:{sandbox:true}} -> Receive 200 with new schedule id and message -> POST /api/scheduler/{schedule_id}/run-now -> Receive 200 with scraper_id, status, exit_code, and duration_ms
POST /api/scheduler/add with body missing cron_expression -> Receive validation error response -> Schedule is not created

POST /api/scheduler/{schedule_id}/pause -> Receive 200 task paused message -> POST /api/scheduler/{schedule_id}/resume -> Receive 200 task resumed message -> DELETE /api/scheduler/{schedule_id} -> Receive 200 task deleted message
POST /api/scheduler/{schedule_id}/pause for unknown schedule_id -> Receive 404 or not-found style error response -> No schedule state is changed

features.name: Diagnostic
features.description: Analyzes HTML structure for a scraper URL, stores snapshots, and compares snapshots to detect structural changes that may break scraping.
user_flows: POST /api/diagnostic/run/xg with body {url:"https://example.com",page_source:"<html>...</html>"} -> Receive 200 with has_changes, severity, changes, snapshot, tab_labels, table_count, and class_hashes -> GET /api/diagnostic/history/xg -> Receive 200 array of stored snapshots -> GET /api/diagnostic/compare/{id1}/{id2} -> Receive 200 comparison result with change summary
POST /api/diagnostic/run/xg with missing url -> Receive request validation error -> No snapshot is created
GET /api/diagnostic/compare/invalid1/invalid2 -> Receive 404 for invalid snapshot IDs -> No comparison is performed
GET /api/diagnostic/history/flashscore after multiple runs -> Receive 200 snapshot list showing HTML evolution over time -> Compare two snapshot IDs to confirm whether structure changed

tech_stack.other: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript vanilla, Chart.js, Flatpickr, Playwright, APScheduler

known_limitations.issue: Script-based scrapers (results, wc2026, elo) cannot use preview/export features
known_limitations.impact: Preview modal shows "No soportado para scripts legacy" for these scrapers

known_limitations.issue: APScheduler may not be installed, scheduler runs in graceful degradation mode
known_limitations.impact: Scheduled jobs register in DB but don't auto-execute without APScheduler

known_limitations.issue: Playwright-based scrapers (flashscore, transfermarkt) require browser binary
known_limitations.impact: Online-only scrapers may fail if Playwright browser is not installed
